newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weakens with screen, cargoes move wes.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weakens with screen, cargoes move wes.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices weakened on Friday as NYMEX futures numbers fell again, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded as high as $190 a tonne fob ARA and as low as $182.50, with prices ending the day somewhere around $187/$189.
An NWE refiner was heard to have sold a 35,000 tonne cargo of Eurograde gasoline to a U.S. buyer at around 5.5 cents under the August NYMEX screen.
But the arbitrage window was still considered closed.

"There are supposed to be traders out there looking to put together pieces to move transatlantic but for me the arb is totally closed still," one NWE refiner said. "I suppose that sale was just done to get rid of the gasoline."
An ARA refiner sold a 60,000 tonne very prompt cargo of catgas to another buyer in the U.S. but no more details were known.
